items.text: Long ago. <break time="0.8s" /> The world was new. <break time="0.8s" /> All the animals. <break time="0.8s" /> Were busy. <break time="0.8s" /> They worked. <break time="0.8s" /> For Man. <break time="0.8s" /> But the Camel lived. <break time="0.8s" /> In the middle of the Howling Desert. <break time="0.8s" /> He was lazy. <break time="0.8s" /> And did not want to work. <break time="0.8s" /> He ate. <break time="0.8s" /> Sticks and thorns. <break time="0.8s" /> All day. <break time="0.8s" /> When anyone spoke to him. <break time="0.8s" /> He said only Humph. <break time="0.8s" /> Just Humph. <break time="0.8s" /> And no more.

Long ago, the world was new. <break time="0.8s" /> All the animals were busy. <break time="0.8s" /> They worked for Man. <break time="0.8s" /> But the Camel lived in the middle of the Howling Desert. <break time="0.8s" /> He was lazy and did not want to work. <break time="0.8s" /> He ate sticks and thorns all day. <break time="0.8s" /> When anyone spoke to him, he said only Humph. <break time="0.8s" /> Just Humph, and no more.

오래전에. <break time="0.8s" /> 세상은 막 생겨났다. <break time="0.8s" /> 모든 동물들은. <break time="0.8s" /> 바빴다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 일했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 사람을 위해. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 낙타는 살았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 울부짖는 사막 한가운데에. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 게을렀다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그래서 일하고 싶지 않았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 먹었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 나뭇가지와 가시를. <break time="0.8s" /> 하루 종일. <break time="0.8s" /> 누가 그에게 말을 걸면. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 흥, 이라고만 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 딱 흥, 한마디. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 더는 없었다.

On Monday morning. <break time="0.8s" /> The Horse came. <break time="0.8s" /> To the Camel. <break time="0.8s" /> Camel, come out. <break time="0.8s" /> And run like us. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the Horse. <break time="0.8s" /> Humph said the Camel. <break time="0.8s" /> Next the Dog came. <break time="0.8s" /> With a stick. <break time="0.8s" /> In his mouth. <break time="0.8s" /> Camel, come. <break time="0.8s" /> And carry things like us. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the Dog. <break time="0.8s" /> The Camel said only Humph again. <break time="0.8s" /> Then the Ox came. <break time="0.8s" /> And said. <break time="0.8s" /> Come and plow with us. <break time="0.8s" /> And again. <break time="0.8s" /> The Camel said, Humph.

On Monday morning, the Horse came to the Camel. <break time="0.8s" /> Camel, come out and run like us, said the Horse. <break time="0.8s" /> Humph, said the Camel. <break time="0.8s" /> Next, the Dog came with a stick in his mouth. <break time="0.8s" /> Camel, come and carry things like us, said the Dog. <break time="0.8s" /> The Camel said only Humph, again. <break time="0.8s" /> Then the Ox came and said, Come and plow with us. <break time="0.8s" /> And again the Camel said, Humph.

월요일 아침에. <break time="0.8s" /> 말이 왔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 낙타에게. <break time="0.8s" /> 낙타야, 나와. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 우리처럼 달려. <break time="0.8s" /> 말이 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 흥 낙타가 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 다음에는 개가 왔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 막대기를 가지고. <break time="0.8s" /> 입에 물고. <break time="0.8s" /> 낙타야, 와. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 우리처럼 물건을 날라. <break time="0.8s" /> 개가 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 낙타는 흥, 이라고만 말했다 또다시. <break time="0.8s" /> 그다음에는 소가 왔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 와서 우리와 함께 밭을 갈자. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 또다시. <break time="0.8s" /> 낙타는 흥, 하고 말했다.

That evening. <break time="0.8s" /> Man called. <break time="0.8s" /> The three animals. <break time="0.8s" /> The Camel will not work. <break time="0.8s" /> So you must work more. <break time="0.8s" /> He said. <break time="0.8s" /> The Horse, the Dog, and the Ox. <break time="0.8s" /> Were very angry. <break time="0.8s" /> Then the Djinn of All Deserts came. <break time="0.8s" /> In a cloud of dust. <break time="0.8s" /> The Camel is lazy. <break time="0.8s" /> Is that right. <break time="0.8s" /> The three asked. <break time="0.8s" /> Certainly not said the Djinn. <break time="0.8s" /> The Djinn found the Camel. <break time="0.8s" /> At a pool of water. <break time="0.8s" /> The Camel was looking at himself. <break time="0.8s" /> In the water.

That evening, Man called the three animals. <break time="0.8s" /> The Camel will not work, so you must work more, he said. <break time="0.8s" /> The Horse, the Dog, and the Ox were very angry. <break time="0.8s" /> Then the Djinn of All Deserts came in a cloud of dust. <break time="0.8s" /> The Camel is lazy, Is that right, the three asked. <break time="0.8s" /> Certainly not, said the Djinn. <break time="0.8s" /> The Djinn found the Camel at a pool of water. <break time="0.8s" /> The Camel was looking at himself in the water.

그날 저녁. <break time="0.8s" /> 사람은 불렀다. <break time="0.8s" /> 세 동물을. <break time="0.8s" /> 낙타는 일하려 하지 않는다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러니 너희가 더 일해야 한다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그가 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 말과 개와 소는. <break time="0.8s" /> 몹시 화가 났다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그때 모든 사막의 진이 왔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 먼지 구름에 휩싸여. <break time="0.8s" /> 낙타는 게을러요. <break time="0.8s" /> 그게 옳은가요. <break time="0.8s" /> 세 동물이 물었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 물론 아니지 진이 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 진은 낙타를 찾아냈다. <break time="0.8s" /> 물웅덩이에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 낙타는 자기 모습을 보고 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 물에 비친.

Why are you not working. <break time="0.8s" /> Asked the Djinn. <break time="0.8s" /> Humph, said the Camel. <break time="0.8s" /> Do not say that again. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the Djinn. <break time="0.8s" /> But the Camel said Humph. <break time="0.8s" /> One more time. <break time="0.8s" /> At once his back puffed up. <break time="0.8s" /> Into a big hump. <break time="0.8s" /> You missed. <break time="0.8s" /> Three days of work. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the Djinn. <break time="0.8s" /> Your hump will help you work. <break time="0.8s" /> For three days without food. <break time="0.8s" /> So the Camel went. <break time="0.8s" /> To work with the three animals. <break time="0.8s" /> And the Camel still has his hump today.

Why are you not working, asked the Djinn, Humph, said the Camel. <break time="0.8s" /> Do not say that again, said the Djinn. <break time="0.8s" /> But the Camel said Humph, one more time. <break time="0.8s" /> At once, his back puffed up into a big hump. <break time="0.8s" /> You missed three days of work, said the Djinn. <break time="0.8s" /> Your hump will help you work for three days without food. <break time="0.8s" /> So the Camel went to work with the three animals. <break time="0.8s" /> And the Camel still has his hump today.

너는 왜 일을 안 하고 있니. <break time="0.8s" /> 진이 물었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 흥, 낙타가 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 말은 다시 하지 마라. <break time="0.8s" /> 진이 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 낙타는 흥, 하고 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 한 번 더. <break time="0.8s" /> 곧바로 그의 등이 부풀어 올랐다. <break time="0.8s" /> 커다란 혹으로. <break time="0.8s" /> 너는 빼먹었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 사흘 동안의 일을. <break time="0.8s" /> 진이 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 네 혹이 네가 일하도록 도와줄 거야. <break time="0.8s" /> 먹지 않고도 사흘 동안. <break time="0.8s" /> 그래서 낙타는 갔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 일하러 세 동물과 함께. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 낙타는 아직도 혹을 달고 있다 오늘날에도.
